notes: v664 - the delayed-price button has been removed. It needed a live quote feed the data plan does not include, so it could only ever report that it could not reach anything, and a button that cannot work is worse than no button - it invites a press and answers with an error. The useful half stays: every pending order still shows on its own row whether your price has been reached, worked out from completed sessions already saved on your device. That never depended on the delayed feed. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
